# KaTeX font notices

The TTF, WOFF and WOFF2 fonts in this directory are unmodified files from `katex@0.16.11`. They are licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1, not the MIT license covering the JavaScript and CSS. See [OFL.txt](OFL.txt).

These copyright, reserved-name and license notices are copied from the bundled TTF name-table entries (name ID 13). Each basename below is supplied in all three formats. KaTeX also confirms its font licensing in [upstream issue 339](https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX/issues/339). The license text is from [SIL's official OFL text](https://openfontlicense.org/open-font-license-official-text/).
